facts.text: Supabase provides an open-source backend platform designed to help developers build and manage applications
Supabase operates as a 100% distributed organization without physical offices across 37 countries
Supabase has over 350 team members across more than 60 countries
Supabase secured $150 million in new funding led by investment firm GIC
Supabase raised $150 million in new funding led by GIC
Supabase acquired Turso to support higher database volumes for agent-driven workloads
Supabase released agentic diagnostic tools enabling coding agents to investigate production problems and test fixes
Supabase launched a prebuilt connector integration within Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise
Supabase has 77 open positions advertised on its career portal
Open engineering positions at Supabase include Platform Engineer for Managed Postgres and Postgres Deployment Engineer
Supabase's tech stack runs on open-source technologies including Postgres, PostgREST, pgvector, and Deno
Supabase's engineering blog publishes deep-dive technical articles on internal tooling and product development
